description: Vonit keeps this chat's thread so another agent can continue it. The hooks only leave a note for the Vonit Connector on this computer; the one on your prompt acts only on /vonit:continue or 'continue in <agent>', which it runs without any model - so it works even at a usage limit. They send nothing themselves and never stop Claude Code otherwise; without the Connector they do nothing.

hooks.command: vonit-connector thread hook SessionStart --agent claude_code 2>/dev/null || true
vonit-connector thread hook Stop --agent claude_code 2>/dev/null || true
vonit-connector thread hook PreCompact --agent claude_code 2>/dev/null || true
vonit-connector thread hook SessionEnd --agent claude_code 2>/dev/null || true
vonit-connector thread hook UserPromptSubmit --agent claude_code 2>/dev/null || true
